programme.title: Battle at Apache Pass
programme.desc: (1952) Western. Apache chief Cochise is trying to keep the peace with the cavalry unit based at Fort Buchanan, but he's undermined by a government advisor and a rival Apache chief.

programme.title: Howards End
programme.desc: (1992) Anthony Hopkins, Helena Bonham Carter and Emma Thompson star in James Ivory's adaptation of EM Forster's novel about two families, love, treachery and revenge.

programme.title: Deep Impact
programme.desc: (1998) Elijah Wood and Morgan Freeman star in the sci-fi disaster movie about impending meteorite-related disaster, attempts to destroy it, and possibly some cataclysmic havoc.

programme.title: The Fabelmans
programme.desc: (2022) Steven Spielberg's semi-autobiographical coming-of-age drama about a young man who dreams of reshaping the world through the medium of film. With Michelle Williams and Seth Rogen.

programme.title: Mean Streets
programme.desc: (1973) Scorsese's classic crime drama about the ordinary lives of mafiosi - the boredom, casual violence and shattered dreams - in Little Italy, with Harvey Keitel and Robert De Niro.

programme.title: Little Monsters
programme.desc: (2019) Undead comedy horror with Lupita Nyong'o. Can an infantile slacker, a diligent teacher and a deranged children's TV presenter rescue a school trip from a zombie outbreak? Head count!

programme.title: Santa Fe

programme.title: The Guns of Fort Petticoat
programme.desc: (1957) Western. A Union army deserter sets out to turn his Texan hometown's womenfolk into sharpshooters in order to repel a Comanche attack. Starring Audie Murphy and Kathryn Grant.

programme.title: The Caine Mutiny
programme.desc: (1954) Oscar-nominated Humphrey Bogart, in one of his finest roles, stars in Edward Dmytryk's gripping drama as Captain Philip Queeg, in charge of a US Navy minesweeper during the war.

programme.title: The Mark of Zorro
programme.desc: (1940) Swashbuckling action-adventure starring Tyrone Power. An aristocrat dons his mask and cape to fight for the rights of the poor in 19th-century California. With Basil Rathbone.

programme.title: The Lost City
programme.desc: (2022) Comedy adventure with Sandra Bullock and Channing Tatum. When a romance novelist is kidnapped wearing a pink jumpsuit, her hapless cover model heads to the jungle to rescue her.

programme.title: The King's Man
programme.desc: (2021) The spy-caper franchise continues with the origins story of the Kingsman agency, as a plucky group battle an international conspiracy at the outbreak of WWI. With Ralph Fiennes.

programme.title: Transporter 3
programme.desc: (2008) Violent action-thriller with Jason Statham. Terrorists hire a courier to drive a kidnapped woman across Europe, on a journey that gets ever more dangerous.

programme.title: The Great Wall
programme.desc: (2017) Fantasy adventure starring Matt Damon and Willem Dafoe. In 11th-century China, Europeans seeking the secret of gunpowder are caught up in a war against alien monsters.

programme.title: The Last Wagon

That was the last time Bafana Bafana competed in a World Cup and, as with their two other tournament appearances in 1998 and 2002, they failed to progress beyond the group stage, whereas El Tricolor finished second in the group to progress to the last-16, where they were beaten 3-1 by Argentina. programme.desc: Germany v Curaçao (Kick-off 6.00pm). Mark Pougatch presents coverage of the Group E match at Houston Stadium in the USA. The Caribbean outfit face one of football's most decorated nations in their first-ever World Cup finals match as they go up against the four-time champions, who have also reached the final on four other occasions. Since their most recent World Cup victory at the 2014 tournament in Brazil, Die Mannschaft have failed to progress from the group stage and have only won two matches at the last two tournaments combined. Julian Nagelsmann's men came through qualifying with a record of five wins and one loss so will be confident of performing better this time around, but will be wary of an opponent they know little about having never faced them before, but who went undefeated in two stages of qualifying in the CONCACAF region. programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Netherlands v Japan (Kick-off 9.00pm). Laura Woods presents coverage of the Group F match at Dallas Stadium in the USA. There have been three previous meetings between these nations, including a group-stage match at the 2010 World Cup in South Africa when a second-half goal from Wesley Sneijder was enough to give the Dutch a 1-0 victory. Both teams went on to progress to the knockout stage, and while the Japanese would bow out in the last-16, Oranje made it all the way to the final but fell short of victory in a 1-0 loss to Spain. Both teams were present at the previous World Cup in Qatar, and both topped their respective groups, with the Dutch leading Group A ahead of Senegal, Ecuador, and the host nation, while Samurai Blue bested Spain, Germany and Costa Rica. The most recent clash between tonight's opponents was a friendly match in 2013 that took place in Belgium, which saw Japan salvage a 2-2 draw after being 2-0 down. With analysis from Roy Keane, Gary Neville and Ange Postecoglu, and commentary by Jon Champion and Ally McCoist

programme.desc: Germany v Curaçao (Kick-off 6.00pm). Mark Pougatch presents coverage of the Group E match at Houston Stadium in the USA. programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Netherlands v Japan (Kick-off 9.00pm). Laura Woods presents coverage of the Group F match at Dallas Stadium in the USA. There have been three previous meetings between these nations, including a group-stage match at the 2010 World Cup in South Africa when a second-half goal from Wesley Sneijder was enough to give the Dutch a 1-0 victory. Both teams went on to progress to the knockout stage, and while the Japanese would bow out in the last-16, Oranje made it all the way to the final but fell short of victory in a 1-0 loss to Spain. Both teams were present at the previous World Cup in Qatar, and both topped their respective groups, with the Dutch leading Group A ahead of Senegal, Ecuador, and the host nation, while Samurai Blue bested Spain, Germany and Costa Rica. The most recent clash between tonight's opponents was a friendly match in 2013 that took place in Belgium, which saw Japan salvage a 2-2 draw after being 2-0 down. With analysis from Roy Keane, Gary Neville and Ange Postecoglu, and commentary by Jon Champion and Ally McCoist

programme.desc: Qatar v Switzerland (Kick-off 8.00pm). Mark Pougatch presents coverage of the Group B match at San Francisco Bay Area Stadium in Santa Clara, USA. Qatar have earned outright qualification for a World Cup for the first time in their history, having made their only previous appearance at the tournament when they served as hosts four years ago. They'll hope to improve on that showing, when they lost all three of their group games against Netherlands, Senegal and Ecuador, scoring just one goal against the Senegalese in the process. There has only ever been one previous meeting between these nations, and Qatar will hope to replicate the outcome of that friendly in 2018, in which they claimed a 1-0 victory. programme.desc: Australia v Türkiye (Kick-off 5.00am). Laura Woods presents coverage of the Group D match at BC Place Vancouver in Canada. The Socceroos are appearing at their sixth consecutive finals, and a seventh overall, and will hope to build on their experience in Qatar four years ago when they progressed to the knockout stage for just the second time. programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Germany v Curaçao (Kick-off 6.00pm). Mark Pougatch presents coverage of the Group E match at Houston Stadium in the USA. The Caribbean outfit face one of football's most decorated nations in their first-ever World Cup finals match as they go up against the four-time champions, who have also reached the final on four other occasions. Since their most recent World Cup victory at the 2014 tournament in Brazil, Die Mannschaft have failed to progress from the group stage and have only won two matches at the last two tournaments combined. Julian Nagelsmann's men came through qualifying with a record of five wins and one loss so will be confident of performing better this time around, but will be wary of an opponent they know little about having never faced them before, but who went undefeated in two stages of qualifying in the CONCACAF region. programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Netherlands v Japan (Kick-off 9.00pm). Laura Woods presents coverage of the Group F match at Dallas Stadium in the USA. There have been three previous meetings between these nations, including a group-stage match at the 2010 World Cup in South Africa when a second-half goal from Wesley Sneijder was enough to give the Dutch a 1-0 victory. Both teams went on to progress to the knockout stage, and while the Japanese would bow out in the last-16, Oranje made it all the way to the final but fell short of victory in a 1-0 loss to Spain. Both teams were present at the previous World Cup in Qatar, and both topped their respective groups, with the Dutch leading Group A ahead of Senegal, Ecuador, and the host nation, while Samurai Blue bested Spain, Germany and Costa Rica. The most recent clash between tonight's opponents was a friendly match in 2013 that took place in Belgium, which saw Japan salvage a 2-2 draw after being 2-0 down. With analysis from Roy Keane, Gary Neville and Ange Postecoglu, and commentary by Jon Champion and Ally McCoist

programme.desc: Spain v Cape Verde (Kick-off 5.00pm). Mark Pougatch presents coverage of the opening match in Group H, held at Atlanta Stadium in the USA. Spain won this tournament in 2010 and are among the favourites to do so once again, having won Euro 2024 and qualified from a group containing Türkiye, Georgia and Bulgaria with five wins, a draw and no defeats. They were also runners-up to Portugal in last year's UEFA Nations League, and their squad boasts the talents of the likes of Barcelona stars Pedri and Lamine Yamal, who is an injury doubt for the group stage, and Manchester City's 2024 Ballon d'or winner Rodri. Cape Verde are one of the tournament outsiders and it would be a major upset should they manage to get a result this evening, but they impressed in qualifying, topping a group that contained the likes of Cameroon, Libya and Angola. They have few players among their ranks who would be widely considered as household names, but are likely to look to captain and all-time leading goalscorer Ryan Mendes for inspiration. programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Germany v Curaçao (Kick-off 6.00pm). Mark Pougatch presents coverage of the Group E match at Houston Stadium in the USA. The Caribbean outfit face one of football's most decorated nations in their first-ever World Cup finals match as they go up against the four-time champions, who have also reached the final on four other occasions. Since their most recent World Cup victory at the 2014 tournament in Brazil, Die Mannschaft have failed to progress from the group stage and have only won two matches at the last two tournaments combined. Julian Nagelsmann's men came through qualifying with a record of five wins and one loss so will be confident of performing better this time around, but will be wary of an opponent they know little about having never faced them before, but who went undefeated in two stages of qualifying in the CONCACAF region. With analysis from Emma Hayes, Juan Mata and Ian Wright, and commentary by Seb Hutchinson and Andros Townsend

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Netherlands v Japan (Kick-off 9.00pm). Laura Woods presents coverage of the Group F match at Dallas Stadium in the USA. There have been three previous meetings between these nations, including a group-stage match at the 2010 World Cup in South Africa when a second-half goal from Wesley Sneijder was enough to give the Dutch a 1-0 victory. Both teams went on to progress to the knockout stage, and while the Japanese would bow out in the last-16, Oranje made it all the way to the final but fell short of victory in a 1-0 loss to Spain. Both teams were present at the previous World Cup in Qatar, and both topped their respective groups, with the Dutch leading Group A ahead of Senegal, Ecuador, and the host nation, while Samurai Blue bested Spain, Germany and Costa Rica. The most recent clash between tonight's opponents was a friendly match in 2013 that took place in Belgium, which saw Japan salvage a 2-2 draw after being 2-0 down. With analysis from Roy Keane, Gary Neville and Ange Postecoglu, and commentary by Jon Champion and Ally McCoist

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Sweden v Tunisia (Kick-off 3.00am). Semra Hunter presents coverage of the Group F match at Monterrey Stadium in Mexico. Sweden have a fairly disappointing record of qualifying for the World Cup in recent times, only appearing three times since they finished third at USA '94, and they had to rely on the UEFA play-offs to secure their spot this time around. For Tunisia this is their third consecutive appearance at a World Cup finals and their seventh overall, and they'll hope to take advantage of the new expanded format and qualify for the knockout stage for the first time. They came up short in Qatar four years ago despite claiming a credible 0-0 draw with Denmark and memorable 1-0 victory over France, with a 1-0 loss to Australia ultimately seeing the Socceroos finish above them in Group D as they progressed to the last 16 alongside eventual runners-up, Les Bleus. With analysis from Karen Carney and Jobi McAnuff, and commentary by Joe Speight and Lucy Ward

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Spain v Cape Verde (Kick-off 5.00pm). Mark Pougatch presents coverage of the opening match in Group H, held at Atlanta Stadium in the USA. Spain won this tournament in 2010 and are among the favourites to do so once again, having won Euro 2024 and qualified from a group containing Türkiye, Georgia and Bulgaria with five wins, a draw and no defeats. They were also runners-up to Portugal in last year's UEFA Nations League, and their squad boasts the talents of the likes of Barcelona stars Pedri and Lamine Yamal, who is an injury doubt for the group stage, and Manchester City's 2024 Ballon d'or winner Rodri. Cape Verde are one of the tournament outsiders and it would be a major upset should they manage to get a result this evening, but they impressed in qualifying, topping a group that contained the likes of Cameroon, Libya and Angola. They have few players among their ranks who would be widely considered as household names, but are likely to look to captain and all-time leading goalscorer Ryan Mendes for inspiration. With analysis from Juan Mata, Emma Hayes and Ange Postecoglou, and commentary by Sam Matterface and Lee Dixon

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Saudi Arabia v Uruguay (Kick-off 11.00pm). Laura Woods presents all the action from both teams' first match in Group H, held at Miami Stadium in the USA. The Saudis caused an upset against South American opposition in their opener four years ago in Qatar when they prevailed 2-1 against eventual champions Argentina, but defeats at the hands of Poland and Mexico ensured that 1994 remained the only time they had progressed beyond the group stage, when the tournament was also held in the USA. Uruguay lifted the trophy in 1930 and 1950, but their run of three consecutive appearances in the knockout stage came to an end in 2022, when they failed to make it out of a group containing Portugal, South Korea and Ghana. The sides also met in the group stage of the 2018 tournament, when a goal by Luis Suarez gave the Uruguayans a 1-0 win. With analysis from Duncan Ferguson, Karen Carney and Jobi McAnuff, and commentary by Joe Speight and Lucy Ward

programme.title: Mother Love
programme.desc: 1989. Stars Diana Rigg, James Wilby & David McCallum. Kit and Angela plan to wed after a whirlwind romance. All goes well until Kit's reluctance to introduce Angela to his mother Helena.

programme.title: The Lawless Years
programme.desc: The Jane Cooper Story. 1959. Stars James Gregory, Rebecca Welles & Henry Corden. Jane Cooper may be on parole, but she intends to improve her status by ditching her boyfriend for a wealthier gangster.

programme.title: Blonde Fist
programme.desc: 1991. Drama. Director: Frank Clarke. Stars Margi Clarke, Carroll Baker & Ken Hutchison. Ronnie flees domestic life to find her father in New York and ends up boxing to make ends meet.

programme.title: Murders In...
programme.desc: Murders in Batz - Les Blessures de l¿île. 2014. Director: Edwin Baily. Stars Stéphane Freiss & Flore Bonaventura. An inspector investigates the island's first murder in a century as storm hits.

programme.title: Star Performance: Backstage
programme.desc: 1952. Drama. Director: Robert Florey. Stars Charles Boyer, Marcia Henderson & Hillary Brooke. An actor helps a struggling woman but gets caught in a mystery when she disappears the next day.

programme.title: Star Treatment Show
programme.desc: 1979 Southern Televisions version of 'Opportunity Knocks!' This week starring: Grace Kennedy. Young entertainers are given a chance to showcase their talent in their own production. (S1, E01)

programme.title: Honey West
programme.desc: 1965. Slay, Gypsy, Slay. Classic crime series produced by Aaron Spelling and starring Anne Francis. Honey and Sam investigate a kidnapping.

programme.title: Danger UXB
programme.desc: The Quiet Weekend. 1979. Stars Anthony Andrews, Judy Geeson & Iain Cuthbertson. Brian has been given time off, his plans to sleep are drastically changed when Susan seeks him out

programme.title: The Adventures of Jim Bowie
programme.desc: Osceola. 1957. Stars Scott Forbes, Abel Fernandez & Peter Hansen. When the army attempts to move the Seminole Indians from their own lands to a less liveable area, Jim steps in to help them.

programme.title: Once a Thief
programme.desc: 1935. Drama. Down on his luck inventor Roger (John Stuart) 'borrows' some money from a handbag he finds but things go wrong when a necklace from the bag goes missing.

programme.title: A Touch Of The Sun
programme.desc: 1956. Comedy. In London's swanky hotel the Royal Connaught, if you need anything ask for Mr. Darling (Frankie Howerd) the ' Mr. Fix-it'. Stars: Ruby Murray, Alfie Bass & Dennis Price.

programme.title: The Angel Who Pawned Her Harp
programme.desc: 1954. Drama starring Felix Aylmer, Diane Cilento and Jerry Desmond. A beautiful angel is sent to The Angel, London, to help people with problems, but she has no money to support herself.

programme.title: Below Zero
programme.desc: 1930. Comedy. Director: James Parrott. Stars Stan Laurel, Oliver Hardy & Charlie Hall. Laurel and Hardy play street musicians struggling to earn money on a cold winter day.

programme.title: Star Performance: The Last Voyage
programme.desc: 1953. Drama. Directed by Robert Florey. Stars Charles Boyer, Jack Lambert & Walter Sande. A sea captain on his final voyage discovers that a time bomb has been planted on his ship.

programme.title: Sergeant Cork
programme.desc: The Case of the Medicine Man. 1964. Stars John Barrie, William Gaunt, John Richmond & Peter Sallis. A priest known as 'Brother Edward' is beaten up and Reverend Wales thinks Edward is in danger...

programme.title: William Tell
programme.desc: The Magic Powder. 1958. Stars: Conrad Phillips, Willoughby Goddard & Jennifer Jayne. Doctor Klein, a scientist working for Gessler, invents an explosive powder for use in roadmaking.

programme.title: Pink String and Sealing Wax
programme.desc: 1946. Drama. Directed by Robert Hamer. Stars Googie Withers, Mervyn Johns & Gordon Jackson. Victorian Brighton; the tale of a pious chemists' household & the underworld occupied by landlady Pearl.

programme.title: Nicole Kidman: Eyes Wide Open
programme.desc: 2023. Director: Patrick Boudet. Nicole Kidman became both a pop culture icon & an actress. Her career is a body of work that mirrors her personal life, which is more political than it might seem.

programme.title: The Card
programme.desc: 1952. Comedy. Director: Ronald Neame. Stars Alec Guinness, Glynis Johns & Valerie Hobson. A man finds ways to rise through the ranks in business and social standing, some honest, some not.

programme.title: What's On TPTV With Noel
programme.desc: Founder of Talking Pictures TV and one half of the Footage Detectives, Noel Cronin, shares shows and films not to be missed throughout June.

programme.title: Whiplash
programme.desc: The Rushing Sands. 1961. Stars Peter Graves, Gordon Glenwright & Barry Linehan. Cobb decides to go after someone called 'Carpenter', one of the calmest and shrewdest killers in the country.

programme.title: The Man from U.N.C.L.E
programme.desc: The Hong Kong Shilling Affair. 1968. Stars Robert Vaughn, David McCallum & Leo G. Carroll. A single shilling is the object of a hunt between U.N.C.L.E and criminal groups in Hong Kong.

programme.title: The Mind of Mr. J. G. Reeder
programme.desc: 1971. The Shadow Man. Stars Hugh Burden, Willoughby Goddard, Mona Bruce. Hallaty, Manager of a Bank has vanished, and a quarter of a million has disappeared from the Vault.

programme.title: The Racing Game
programme.desc: The Gambling Lady. 1979. Stars Mike Gwilym, Mick Ford & Caroline Blakiston. Sid and Chico are hired to investigate a potential insurance scam. They have to travel to Milan to discover the truth.

programme.title: Curse of Frankenstein
programme.desc: 1957. Horror. Directed by Terence Fisher. Stars Peter Cushing, Hazel Court & Robert Urquhart. Frankenstein recounts the story of when he assembled and brought to life an untamed monster.

programme.title: Fortean TV
programme.desc: 1997. Hosted by Reverend Lionel Fanthorpe. Tonight, meet a cow that some people believe to be holy, a couple who saw a vision of a 100 year old Monk and watch rare footage of the Swedish lake monster.

programme.title: Arizona Dream
programme.desc: 1993. Drama. Director: Emir Kusturica. Stars Johnny Depp, Faye Dunaway, Vincent Gallo. A young New Yorker goes to Arizona for a wedding and becomes intertwined in the lives of two eccentric women.

programme.title: Look At Life Down London River
programme.desc: 1962. A Look into a leisurely journey through London along the Thames.

programme.title: Target: The Corruptors
programme.desc: The Wrecker. 1961. Stars Stephen McNally, Robert Harland & Harold J. Stone. Investigative reporters Paul Marino & Jack Flood investigate various cases of industrial corruption. (S1, E22)

programme.title: Tell Me Another
programme.desc: Disasters, Humiliations & Embarrassing Moments In Their Personal & Professional Lives. 1976. Personal anecdotes as told to Dick Hills. This episode stars Diana Dors, Jimmy Jewel and Ted Ray.

programme.title: Danger UXB
programme.desc: Digging Out. 1979. Stars Anthony Andrews, Judy Geeson & Kenneth Cranham. Working on a bomb at a gas works, the company finds a second bomb with a time fuze

programme.title: Lancashire Luck
programme.desc: 1937. Comedy. Director: Henry Cass. Stars George Carney, Wendy Hiller & Muriel George. A working class family win a fortune and enjoy the high life after moving to an upper class part of town.

programme.title: To Dorothy A Son
programme.desc: 1954. Comedy. Director Muriel Box. Starring John Gregson, Shelley Winters & Peggy Cummins. Myrtle stands to inherit $2,000,000 if her ex doesn't have any male heirs, if he does, he gets the cash.

programme.title: Cinebox Memories
programme.desc: Let's get dancing! Enjoy this fantastic performance from Lionel and Joyce Blair as they dance to the 60s hit 'Must Be Madison'.

programme.title: Those People Next Door
programme.desc: 1953. Drama. Directed by John Harlow and starring Jack Warner, Charles Victor, Jimmy James & Anthony Newley. A young man's titled parents object to his working-class fiance.

programme.title: The Laurel-Hardy Murder Case
programme.desc: 1930. Comedy. Director: James Parrott. Stars Stan Laurel, Oliver Hardy, Frank Austin, Stanley Blystone. Laurel & Hardy get involved in a murder case after the death of Stan's rich uncle Ebenezer.

programme.title: Star Performance: Meet McGraw
programme.desc: 1954. Drama. Director: Frank McDonald. Stars Frank Lovejoy, Audrey Totter & Ellen Corby. A private detective is hired to protect a woman after she claims that her husband is planning to kill her.

programme.title: Sergeant Cork
programme.desc: The Case of the Dumb Witness. 1964. Stars John Barrie & Warren Mitchell. Sergeant Cork is called to help with a spate of burglaries but Leavis is unconvinced by his methods.

programme.title: The Buccaneers
programme.desc: The Articles of War. 1956. Stars Robert Shaw, Eric Pohlmann & Brian Rawlinson. The island is running out of food and a Spanish naval ship threatens to destroy the next shipment.

programme.title: Dressed to Kill
programme.desc: 1946. Drama. Director: Roy William. Stars Basil Rathbone, Nigel Bruce, Patricia Morison & Edmond Breon. Sherlock Holmes & Dr. Watson hunt for the elusive plates before counterfeiters acquire them.

programme.title: Dial 999
programme.desc: Mechanical Watchman. 1958. Stars Robert Beatty, John Howlett & Peter Allenby. Maguire catches a fur coat thief in the act; however, the other members of the gang remain unknown.

programme.title: Mrs. Pym of Scotland Yard
programme.desc: 1939. Detective Drama. Directed by Fred Elles. Starring Mary Clare, Edward Lexy & Nigel Patrick. A woman detective sets about solving the murder of people who have all frequented the same medium.

programme.title: Mr Denning Drives North
programme.desc: 1951. Crime. Director: Anthony Kimmins. Stars John Mills, Phyllis Calvert & Eileen Moore. A British aircraft engineer accidentally kills his daughter's boyfriend and then tries to it cover up...

programme.title: Give Us A Clue
programme.desc: 1985. The classic game show Give us a Clue hosted by Michael Parkinson, this week's guests are Lynda Bellingham, Robin Cousins, Tim Flavin, Bonnie Langford, Paul Nicholas and Marti Webb.

programme.title: Out of Town
programme.desc: Bee Skeps/Flooded River Fishing. 1978. This specially preserved episode shows a traditional bee skep being made. Then, planning to fish in a stream on Salisbury Plain, Jack finds it in flood.

programme.title: Scotland Yard
programme.desc: 1961. The Never Never Murder. Directed by Peter Duffell. Starring Russell Napier, Genine Graham and Maurice Good. A dead body sets the police on the track of a fraudster. (S1, E37)

programme.title: Francis Durbridge's A Man Called Harry Brent
programme.desc: The Pen. 1965. Stars Edward Brayshaw, Gerald Harper & Jennifer Daniel. Mrs Tolly's husband puts a devious plan in action to obtain Mr Fielding's fountain pen.

programme.title: Travelling Man
